placedBecause: an artifact written by a run outside the test process

witness.recorder: the process exit status itself, read by the shell — 141 is 128 + 13 and is reported by the kernel rather than by any code under test

armedBy: The negative arm is the standalone probe at exit 141, recorded before the fix. With SO_NOSIGPIPE removed the test process dies at the write and the suite reports nothing at all — which is how the fault presented and why nothing had caught it.
